F2 — Counterevidence: Direct Definition8 construction, finite-projection PDE, Gaussian Fourier uniqueness, and global L1 passage were independently checked after bounded repairs. No failure of main existence/uniqueness is established.

proposition.claim:
The limiting noise coefficient is beta*rho, not beta.

Tensor normalization, divergence norm/domain, random-function scope and endpoint heat normalization are inconsistent.

Ordered Gaussian pairs lack1/2; circle example uses incompatible critical convention; polymer cylinder formula lacks deterministic heat denominator.

Time-mass scaling and several constants/powers are wrong; Prop84 cannot be uniform with prefactor1; Prop85 needs centered cutoff and additional conditional-bound argument.

repair.content:
Target z_(nu*rho,beta*rho), or planar coefficient beta/rho. Corresponding polymer coupling must agree.

Use consistent symmetrization and actual divergence domain; add Definition10 finite-mass condition when needed; correct heat factor; integrate endpoint in Tonelli bound.

Use j<ell; use gamma<1 (or halve exponential coefficient consistently); divide cylinder heat products by endpoint heat kernel.

Correct t²/|detL|, Stirling factor, gamma*t, t², squared phi and Gaussian prefactor. Prop77 intended limit independently completed via nonnegative kernel and endpoint/collision cutoffs. For84 retain prefactor, enlarge covering windows, use N-scaled Gaussian weight; for85 center Holder norm and prove only needed fixed-cutoff uniform-N estimate. Unequal block starting points are handled by moment-density Cauchy-Schwarz and translation-covariant self cutoffs, not independent translation of the cross local time. This completes the needed weak fixed-r uniform-N estimate.
